title: 第三千五百九十七章 新电影第三千六百章 正常世界
content_zh:
“恶魔，变聪明了啊。”
中间人惊讶的说道，随即祂想到什么，看了安德鲁一眼，难道这就是机械魔王的目的？
恶魔能想到这个方法，完全是受机械魔王影响，否则，打死祂也想不到这么好的作弊手段，机械魔王是个老银币，不可能不知道这个后果，所以，这很可能是个陷阱。
随即，中间人摇了摇头，是不是陷阱关老子屁事，老子都快疯了，恶魔，西索恩祂们无论是死亡，还是失败，都不关祂的事。
“什么叫变聪明，老子从一开始就很聪明，否则怎么当地狱之主？”
恶魔嚣张的说道，中间人想翻白眼，你这地狱之主不是天生的吗？
多元宇宙，很多神灵和魔神都是天生的，包括秩序之主，混乱之主，甚至是上帝，都是一出生就站在高位，所以这些人未必十分聪明，十分狡猾，因为祂们的成功，不需要这些。
“恶魔，你的作弊手段理论上是可行的，每个光点都保持自我意识。”
中间人说道：“但记忆上会有限制，光点能承受的记忆并不多。
其实，之所以进入剧情世界的是一缕灵魂，而不是以光点的形式存在，是因为只有一缕灵魂，才能承受所有记忆。
也就是说，光点只能承受部分记忆，不过问题不大，可以将剩下的记忆封印，随着祂们变强，逐渐解封记忆。”
恶魔想了想，点头道：“这个可以，只要所有光点都是恶魔，知晓此行的目的，那就行，至于拥有多少记忆，问题不大，反正能逐步解封。”
“另外，所有意识可以相互连接这件事，我会写进你的人物设定里。”
中间人继续道：“但进入剧本世界后，究竟能不能成功，是未知之数，前面那个倒是肯定没问题。
后者的话，如果不成功，可能需要你们见面，才能相互连接。”
“这样啊？也行，关键是前面那个不能出问题，反正都是我，晚点连接也没什么。”
恶魔想了想，说道：“只要在报纸上登一个我们都知道的消息，就能轻松知晓对方的存在。”
中间人说道：“好，你的作弊手段，就这样定下了，正好魔法阵快开启了。”
“看来我想的很及时，这要多亏机械魔王，没有他的话，我还真想不到这个手段。”
恶魔得意洋洋的说道，中间人无语的看了祂一眼，这明显是个坑啊，你居然还这么兴高采烈？

当然，就像之前说的，中间人不打算做什么，因此，祂没有劝诫恶魔，也没有把这件事告诉西索恩祂们。
西索恩倒是关心了一下恶魔，问祂想出作弊手段没有，如果没有的话，祂可以提供一个——很明显，祂是想把恶魔当成工具人使用。
“不用了，我自己想出来了，我的作弊手段，会比你们更加高明。”
恶魔嚣张的说道：“我知道你肯定想问我是什么作弊手段，不好意思，我不会告诉你们，你们这些家伙，没一个值得信任。”
西索恩无所谓的耸了耸肩，祂不觉得恶魔能想出什么高明的手段，反正肯定没祂的高明，只要恶魔不和机械魔王联络就行，其他事情好说。
content_en:
"Devil, you've become smarter."
The middleman said in surprise. Then he thought of something and glanced at Andrew. Is this the purpose of the Mechanical Demon King?
The devil was able to think of this method entirely because of the influence of the Mechanical Demon King. Otherwise, even if he were killed, he would not have thought of such a good cheating method. The Mechanical Demon King is an old silver coin, so it is impossible not to know the consequences, so this is probably a trap.
Immediately, the middleman shook his head. Whether it was a trap or not was none of my business. I was going crazy. Devil, Sithorn and the others, whether they died or failed, it was none of his business.
"What does it mean to become smart? I have been smart from the beginning. Otherwise, how could I be the Lord of Hell?"
The devil said arrogantly, and the middleman wanted to roll his eyes, aren't you the lord of hell born?
In the multiverse, many gods and demons are born, including the Lord of Order, the Lord of Chaos, and even God. They all stand in high positions from birth, so these people may not be very smart or cunning, because their success does not require these.
"Devil, your cheating method is theoretically feasible. Every point of light maintains self-awareness."
The intermediary said: "But there are limitations on memory, and the light spot can not bear many memories.
In fact, the reason why it is a ray of soul that enters the plot world instead of existing in the form of a point of light is because only a ray of soul can bear all the memories.
In other words, the light spots can only withstand part of the memory, but it is not a big problem. They can seal the remaining memories and gradually unblock the memories as they become stronger. "
The demon thought for a while, nodded and said: "That's okay. As long as all the light spots are demons and know the purpose of this trip, that's fine. As for how many memories it has, it's not a big problem. Anyway, it can be gradually unblocked."
"In addition, I will write it into your character setting that all consciousnesses can be connected to each other."
The intermediary continued: "But after entering the script world, it is unknown whether it will be successful. The previous one is definitely no problem.
The latter, if unsuccessful, may require you to meet in person to connect with each other. "
"Is that so? That's okay. The key is that there can't be any problems with the front one. It's all me anyway. It doesn't matter if I connect later."
The devil thought for a while and said: "As long as we publish a piece of news in the newspaper that we both know, we can easily know the other party's existence."
The middleman said: "Okay, your cheating method has been decided, and the magic circle is about to open."
"It seems that I thought in time. This is thanks to the Mechanical Demon King. Without him, I really wouldn't have thought of this method."
The devil said triumphantly, and the middleman glanced at him speechlessly. This is obviously a trap. Are you still so happy?
Of course, as said before, the middleman did not intend to do anything, so he did not admonish the demons, nor did he tell Sithorn and the others about it.
Sithorn was concerned about the devil and asked him if he had come up with a way to cheat. If not, he could provide one - obviously, he wanted to use the devil as a tool.
"No need, I figured it out myself. My cheating methods will be better than yours."
The devil said arrogantly: "I know you definitely want to ask me what my cheating method is. I'm sorry, I won't tell you. None of you guys are trustworthy."
Sithorn shrugged indifferently. He didn't think the devil could come up with any clever methods. Anyway, it was definitely not as clever as him. As long as the devil didn't contact the Machine Demon King, other things were easy to talk about.
